title: Clockify Time Entry Duration Leaderboard
dataSources: RescueTime activity (`rescuetime:activity`), Apple/Android screen-time exports (`screentime:usage`), GitHub events (`github:personal`), habit-tracker logs (`habit:entry`), calendar/todo exports.
app: Screen-time / RescueTime exports, GitHub personal activity, habit/journal trackers, and calendar feeds via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=clockify:entry duration_min=*
| stats sum(duration_min) as total_value, avg(duration_min) as avg_value by project_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks project values by total and average duration across Clockify time entry events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `duration_min` values for each Clockify time entry event and review total and average duration by project.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total duration.
grandmaExplanation: It smartly which project shows the biggest duration numbers in your Clockify time entry data.
